custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have five parts, part A, part B, part C, part D and part E, each with one bin location that holds a quantity above 0 (no bin below zero), so the sort and the Total Qty cells agree.
    • How to do it: Create the five parts as below, one at a time.
  • Set parts A, B and C as tracked parts, with 5, 5 and 2 on hand.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C154775 PART A ALPHA in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154775-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 5 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C154775 PART B BRAVO in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154775-B in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 5 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C154775 PART C CHARLIE in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154775-C in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 2 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Set parts D and E as untracked parts, with 1 and 9 on their shelf.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C154775 PART D XRAY in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154775-D in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, click Track quantities and cost of goods off, type 1 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C154775 PART E YANKEE in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154775-E in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, click Track quantities and cost of goods off, type 9 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Give parts A, B, C, D and E descriptions that start with the same text and end, in turn, with ALPHA, BRAVO, CHARLIE, XRAY and YANKEE.
    • How to do it: The descriptions above all start ZZAUTOTEST PL C154775 PART.
  • Give parts A, B, C, D and E part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists all five.
    • How to do it: The part numbers above all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154775-.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
